div.h1: How the substrate and engines assemble into an agent
div.p:
Perception turns the world into facts, the substrate holds the ontology and closure and provenance, reasoning materializes and checks, decision plans, and action is proof-gated.
The belief-revision edge feeds retractions back into the substrate.
